page.layout: One page of running text, with marginal notes in the left margin only. Printed page number 80 at the head left, running head at the top centre-right. The verse stanza is set in italic lines between the two paragraphs. Catchword at the lower right. A faint show-through in the right margin is not transcribed.

main_text.p: a Bernard. Breidenb. peregrinat. montis Sinai.Erasmo scriptum, in naufragii sæpe discrimine versantes, ad eam (ut {a}Pontificius narrat, qui interfuit,) devotius clamitabant, cantantes crebro hos versus:

* Missal. Sarisbur. infr. octav. assum. B. Mariæ die 7. & Breviar. in Missa quotidiana de B. Maria.{*}Salve splendor firmamenti,
Tu caliginosæ menti
Desuper irradia:
Placa mare, maris stella
Ne involvat nos procella,
Et tempestas obvia.

b Horat. lib.1 carm. od.3.c Ovid. Heroid. epist.15.Ita, quod Pagani Venerem orabant, {b}Sicte Diva potens Cypri; quippe qui putarent ab ea regi navigantes, {c}in mare nimirum ius habet orta mari: id nautas a Maria petere sub Papatu, itaque Virginem lectissimam in præfectura maris turpissimo scorto substituere, indicat Erasmus. Et cuius iniquitatis est asseverare, hoc profana audacia & more prorsus Lucianeo ab illo factum esse: quod ille a Papistis Gentilitio prorsus more factum notat, & sanctalibertate loquendi vellicat, perstringitque? Sanctus {d}Epiphanius, infectans Collyridianos, qui placentam eidem Virgini offerebant, & quasi sacrificabant. Ha fœmina, inquit, rursum instaurant {e}fortunæ mixtam potionem, & mensam dæmoni parant, non Deo, sicuti scriptum est: & {f}fœminæ depsunt maßam, ac filij ligna colligunt, ut faciant placentas militiæ cœli: compescantur a Jeremia tales fœminæ, & ne turbent orbem terrarum; ne dicant, {g}honoramus reginam cœli. Quibus in verbis comparat Mariam, non prout est; absit; sed ut a Collyridianis hæreticis colebatur, Beatam, inquam, Virginem comparat cum fortuna, cum dæmone, cum {h}sideribus, cum reginacœli. Ac reginæ cœli nomine fortassis exiftimavit

page.notes: Marginal notes, left side, as printed: "a Bernard. Breidenb. peregrinat. montis Sinai."; "* Missal. Sarisbur. infr. octav. assum. B. Mariæ die 7. & Breviar. in Missa quotidiana de B. Maria."; "b Horat. lib.1 carm. od.3."; "c Ovid. Heroid. epist.15."; "d Heref.79." (the abbreviation is doubtful, possibly Haer.); "e Efai. 65.11. secundum Septuaginta interpr." (the margin letter reads as c or e; the text mark before fortunæ is taken as e); "f Ierem.7.18."; "g Ierem. 44. 17."; "h Ier.8.2.". Doubtful readings: "Heref" (f or s); "ius habet" in the Ovid quotation; "Pontificius" as printed; "caliginosæ" and "Desuper" are read from the long-s forms. The mark on "fœminæ" after "&" is read as f. The handwritten underlining under "Collyridianos", "Virgini offerebant" and "in mare nimirum" is ink and not transcribed. Show-through in the right margin omitted.
